notes: A review can belong to more than one theme. Example ids come from the proposal slices, never from eval/eval_ids.json.

themes.name: General praise and everyday usefulness
themes.definition: Clear positive statements about ChatGPT or the app, including praise that appears alongside a complaint or request.
includes: helps with work, business, writing, recipes, ideas
praise for fast or smooth responses
convenience of having the app on the phone
free version being generous or no ads
clear praise even when the review also complains

1: General praise and everyday assistant use

themes.name: Education and homework help
themes.definition: Reviews about using ChatGPT for studying, homework, research, exam prep, learning new skills or languages, or as a personal tutor.
includes: exam prep such as IIT JEE
learning new topics, skills or languages
excludes: general praise with no learning use case
complaints about wrong answers in school subjects

1: Praise for study and learning help

themes.name: Login, sign-up and account problems
themes.definition: Difficulty signing in, signing up, staying logged in, verifying identity, or recovering or deleting accounts.
includes: cannot log in, login loops or stuck screens
phone number or birth date requirements

2: Login, signup and account access problems

themes.name: Crashes, errors and connectivity
themes.definition: The app not working reliably: crashing, freezing, not opening, showing error messages, losing connection, stopping mid-response, or being slow and laggy.
includes: crashes on open or app closing by itself
infinite loading or app not opening
'request is not allowed', 'try again later' or 'request is invalid' errors
false network or connection errors despite good connection
slowness and lag, including slow typing or slow scrolling in long chats
excludes: layout or design complaints with no failure or slowness

1: Crashes, freezing and app won't open
2: Performance, interface and chat history behavior (slowness only)

themes.name: Wrong, unreliable or outdated answers
themes.definition: Complaints that responses are factually wrong, hallucinated, inconsistent, poor at following instructions, or based on outdated training data (e.g. a 2021 or 2022 cutoff).
includes: forgetting earlier context in a chat

themes.name: Bias, censorship and privacy concerns
themes.definition: Objections to perceived political, religious or ideological bias, over-restrictive or preachy content policies, offensive content about groups, and data collection or privacy practices.
includes: religious bias or offensive content about religions or groups
phone number demands as privacy invasion

themes.name: Missing features compared with the web version
themes.definition: Requests for features the website has but the Android app lacks, or other functionality users expect, and complaints that the app is less capable than the browser version.
includes: plugins, code interpreter and beta features
excludes: existing features that display or behave badly (UI)

2: Missing features compared with the web version

themes.name: Image generation and multimodal requests
themes.definition: Requests or complaints about creating, showing or understanding images, documents and other media.
includes: wanting images, flowcharts, music or video in answers

themes.name: Voice chat and audio
themes.definition: Feedback on voice conversation, speech recognition, text-to-speech and read-aloud: quality, language recognition, volume, cut-offs and availability, both praise and bugs.
includes: poor audio quality or low in-call volume
wrong voice or audio output route
read-aloud bugs or missing voice transcript

themes.name: Pricing, subscription and usage limits
themes.definition: Feedback about subscription cost and value, billing problems, regional affordability, paywalled features, message caps and model switching on paid or free plans.
includes: subscription too expensive, including for my country
GPT-4 or GPT-4o message limits and free plan limits
being switched or defaulted to an older model
excludes: general praise that mentions the app being free

themes.name: UI, UX and accessibility
themes.definition: Issues with how the Android interface looks and behaves: layout, scrolling, keyboard, theming, accessibility, chat history behavior, and how math and formulas are rendered.
includes: chat history not loading, syncing, disappearing or hard to navigate
raw LaTeX shown instead of symbols, unreadable formulas
excludes: slowness or lag (Crashes, errors and connectivity)
wrong math answers (Wrong, unreliable or outdated answers)

2: Performance, interface and chat history behavior (interface and chat history)

themes.name: Other
themes.definition: Reviews that fit no other theme, such as vague, off-topic or non-substantive comments, and requests for non-English language or regional support.
includes: non-English language support or replies in the wrong language
excludes: regional pricing complaints (Pricing, subscription and usage limits)
